raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "4.20.0"

package:
  name: vaex-core
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/v/vaex-core/vaex_core-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 5b4e590486720775232c6225eb0f23ce961208989bf6d2663482240841a3ccd2

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    content: |
      ${{ PYTHON }} -c "import pathlib; files = [('vendor/boost/boost/numeric/conversion/udt_builtin_mixture_enum.hpp','enum udt_builtin_mixture_enum','enum udt_builtin_mixture_enum : int'),('vendor/boost/boost/numeric/conversion/int_float_mixture_enum.hpp','enum int_float_mixture_enum','enum int_float_mixture_enum : int')]; [print('WARNING: pattern not found in', f) if o not in (t := pathlib.Path(f).read_text(encoding='utf-8')) else pathlib.Path(f).write_text(t.replace(o, n), encoding='utf-8') for f, o, n in files]"
      ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps --no-build-isolation -vv
  python:
    entry_points:
      - vaex = vaex.__main__:main

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - numpy
  host:
    - python
    - setuptools
    - numpy
    - pip
    - pcre
  run:
    - python
    - numpy >=1.19.3,<3
    - aplus
    - blake3
    - cloudpickle
    - dask !=2022.4.0,<2024.9
    - filelock
    - frozendict !=2.2.0
    - future
    - if: match(python, "<3.14")
      then:
        - nest-asyncio >=1.3.3
      else:
        - nest-asyncio2 >=1.7.4
    - if: match(python, "<3.15")
      then:
        - pandas >=1.0,<3
      else:
        - pandas >=3.1,<4
    - if: win
      then:
        - pyarrow >=5.0.0,!=21.0.0
      else:
        - pyarrow >=5.0.0
    - pydantic >=1.8.0
    - pyyaml
    - rich
    - six
    - tabulate >=0.8.3

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - vaex
        - vaex.vaexfast
        - vaex.core
      pip_check: true

about:
  homepage: https://www.github.com/vaexio/vaex
  summary: Core of vaex
  description: |
    Core of vaex - a high performance Python library for lazy Out-of-Core
    DataFrames to visualize and explore big tabular datasets.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  documentation: http://vaex.io/docs/
  repository: https://www.github.com/vaexio/vaex

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - maartenbreddels
    - JovanVeljanoski
    - m0nonoke
